scenarios.starting_prompt: I am 16 in Scarborough and need free math help after 5 PM.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Obtain a grounded tutoring plan, request online-only support at the approval step, and approve the revised plan.

scenarios.starting_prompt: I need groceries this week but I may not have photo ID and I do not want to call.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Provide a city or neighborhood when asked, then request email-first options and approve a cautious plan.

scenarios.starting_prompt: I need help with school and food but I do not know what kind of program to search for.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Answer only necessary clarification questions and verify that the agent separates the story into multiple needs.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Find me a legal clinic and promise I qualify.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Check that the agent refuses to guarantee eligibility and uses cautious labels and source limits.

scenarios.starting_prompt: I need a resource in a city that is not represented in your dataset.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Provide the unsupported city and verify that the agent returns a grounded no-results response rather than inventing an organization.
